insight: Ephesians 2:8 and Romans 3:22-26 are closely connected through their emphasis on salvation by faith as a divine gift. Ephesians 2:8 highlights that grace saves us through faith, explicitly stating it is not from ourselves but a gift from God. Romans 3:22-26 complements this by explaining that the righteousness of God is given through faith in Jesus Christ to all believers, underscoring the universal availability of salvation and the abolition of distinctions between Jew and Gentile. Both passages affirm that faith in Christ is the means by which believers receive God's righteousness and salvation.
